toegepas.voor: lê 'n dun dowwe lagie oor blink metaal
toegepas.na: lê 'n dun dowwe lagie oor die blink metaal
toegepas.rede_vinder: The article makes it clear the shiny metal is the coin's own metal underneath, which reads more naturally.
toegepas.fout: 'oor blink metaal' reads as a generic statement where the sentence means the metal of the old copper and silver itself.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The article ties the shiny metal to the object under the layer and prepares 'die blink metaal' in the next sentence, without changing the claim.

toegepas.voor: Skuur haal die lagie af en die blink metaal
toegepas.na: Skuur haal die lagie af, en die blink metaal
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining 'Skuur haal die lagie af' and 'die blink metaal wys weer'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Two clauses each with their own subject and verb take the comma under the AWS 2017.

toegepas.voor: Kryt het geen sulke lagie nie en skuur
toegepas.na: Kryt het nie so 'n lagie nie, en skuur
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'so 'n lagie' is the natural singular form instead of 'sulke lagie', and the AWS comma is needed before 'en' joining two clauses.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' between two full clauses; 'geen sulke lagie nie' is stiff for a singular noun.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma is required and 'nie so 'n lagie nie' is the natural singular form, with the negation and meaning unchanged.

toegepas.na: wanneer iemand dit probeer buig nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: Chalk cannot be bent, so 'probeer buig' avoids saying someone bends it while the sentence says it does not bend.
toegepas.fout: The sentence says someone bends the chalk while saying it does not bend, which makes a reader stumble.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'probeer buig' removes the self-contradiction and keeps the claim that chalk breaks instead of bending.

toegepas.voor: Daardie selfde harde klip breek tog in stukke wanneer 'n hamer hom hard
toegepas.na: Dieselfde harde klip breek tog in stukke wanneer 'n hamer dit hard
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Dieselfde' is the natural form instead of 'daardie selfde', and 'dit' is the standard written pronoun for an object.
toegepas.fout: 'Daardie selfde' copies English 'that same', and 'hom' for a stone is informal in written study text.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Dieselfde' and 'dit' are the standard written forms and the sentence says exactly the same; the protected thumb sentence before it is untouched.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'wat hulle waarmee maak' is a compressed, hard-to-parse construction for a Grade 5 reader.
toegepas.fout: 'besluit wat hulle waarmee maak' is a compressed double-question construction that a Grade 5 reader stumbles over.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Checked the preposition: both say people choose which material to make a thing from, which the next two sentences ('van metaal gemaak', 'van klip gebou') confirm, so the meaning holds and the sentence is easier to read.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Albei soorte' has no noun and the reader must guess what kinds are meant; 'materiaal' makes the reference clear.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Baie plastiek' reads as 'a lot of plastic'; 'baie soorte plastiek' says many kinds, which is what is meant, and keeps the qualifier.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Baie plastiek' (many plastic things) is natural, and 'baie soorte plastiek' moves the claim to kinds of plastic, when whether plastic shines depends on its surface finish rather than its kind.
